standard_title: AWS A3.0M/A3.0:2020 Standard Welding Terms and Definitions

cost_and_replay_qualification.cost_qualification: No per-query external API charge in offline deterministic/replay mode; local compute, storage, and maintenance costs still apply. Live DeepSeek-V4.1 API calls incur normal token/endpoint charges and network latency.
cost_and_replay_qualification.replay_isolation: 100% network-blocked via socket.socket interception during benchmark runs.
